title: Fence Jump Plus
body:
# Fence Jump Plus

**Tired of fences stopping you in your tracks?** With this mod you simply jump over fences, walls and fence gates — no carpets, no trapdoors, no parkour tricks needed.

> This is an unofficial fork/reupload based on the original [**Jump Over Fences**](https://modrinth.com/mod/jump-over-fences) mod, licensed under the MIT License.

## ✨ Features

* 🪵 **Jump over fences** — all wooden and nether brick fences
* 🧱 **Jump over walls** — cobblestone, blackstone and every other wall
* 🚪 **Jump over fence gates** — closed gates are no obstacle anymore
* 🏷️ **Tag support** — works automatically with modded fences/walls via block tags
* ⚙️ **Configurable** — add any custom block (e.g. `cfm:oak_upgraded_fence`) to the jump list via the config
* 🖥️ **Client-side only** — works on servers, no server-side installation required

## 📦 Requirements

| Dependency    | Required                         |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Fabric Loader | ✅                                |
| Fabric API    | ✅                                |
| Cloth Config  | ✅                                |
| Mod Menu      | optional (for the config screen) |

## 🎮 Supported Versions

* **Minecraft 26.1 – 26.1.2** (Java 25)
* **Minecraft 1.21.9 – 1.21.11** (Java 21)

## 🔧 Configuration

The config file `config/jumpoverfences.toml` lets you add extra blocks to jump over.
With **Mod Menu** installed you can edit everything in-game.
